author: Zazzi
subject: H-RP | <The Wayfarers> | Checking for interest!
content_md:
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/mKgcsuP.png)
> The Wayfarers are a small, nomadic group founded to combat not the Alliance, but the existential threats that hide themselves in the forgotten corners of Azeroth. As the enterprise is still in its infancy, recruitment for talented but inexperienced (or eccentric) individuals has commenced, with the gathering point of Razor Hill. Word has been sent to Thunder Bluff and Undercity, and favours have been called in to point like-minded souls in our direction.
>
>  We are strongly affiliated with the Horde and follow the principles that bind the races together: freedom from oppression, from persecution, and the ability to forge one’s own path in this war-torn world. There must be, if not harmony, then at least tolerance of different walks of life. Nobody’s saying you’ve got to kiss a Forsaken, but at least try and make nice.
>
>  Wayfarers can be anyone, from a trainee to an old-hand –– all would-be adventurers chomping at the bit for a chance to prove themselves are welcomed. If you are such a person, whether you seek power, riches, knowledge or glory (or all four at once), you might find your calling with us.
>
>  But before you pledge your sword, shield or spells, know this: those who wander off the beaten path will find themselves in constant peril, surrounded by dangerous creatures and environments alike. The pay is adequate at best, and the road long, but the knowledge that your actions could save countless lives and allow the Horde to further advance into uncharted territory should be more than enough recompense.
>
>  And if it *isn’t* enough, well, there's always the treasure.

Join a campfire-sitting, dungeon-crawling, turtle-saving band of adventurers in their travels across Azeroth and go from zero to hero over the course of sixty levels and countless /emotes. Prior experience of roleplaying is unnecessary, so long as you take it seriously (but not too seriously!). Fans of *Critical Role* and *The Adventure Zone* will feel especially at home!

Other than bog-standard campfire roleplay, we will likely be using game mechanics to create ‘plotted’ roleplaying encounters quickly and efficiently. Party up to explore zones, complete quests, or gather resources while in character, or cut your teeth in a dungeon with other adventurers. (It might make Wailing Caverns a four hour dungeon instead of two…) If these dry up, there is always the possibility of running DM’d encounters or a mission board of some kind –– but that’s something to consider for the future.

House rules are pretty simple and nothing new to those familiar with roleplaying etiquette. Choose lore-friendly names, keep public channels clean (if your great, unbridled passion cannot be contained, take it to /whisper) and don't hate on others on the grounds of race, sexuality, religion, etc. Or for any reason, really.

Obviously, it is not expected for all guild members be roleplaying full-time, and not all dungeon and quest runs will require them to be fully-acted out. In fact, most won’t. For the roleplayers, one of the main goals of the guild is to recreate true, lore-friendly character arcs, something that seems to have faded in recent expansions. We also welcome anyone interested in ‘taking it slow’ in the true spirit of the server as socials, so long as they are respectful of the guild's main interests.

There's more ideas buzzing around that I'm not going to get into here, including a possible OOC gathering during the upcoming beta. Tag me on Discord (Holly#4732) if you have pressing questions or want to express interest in a more casual way than posting on the forums – I already have a list of people to chase up when the server goes live. I desperately wish there was more roleplaying discussion on the forum, as I think it's a nice niche for the server to look into, so here's hoping this sparks some!

author: Zazzi
subject: Re: H-RP | <The Wayfarers> | Checking for interest!
content_md:
> Hi all! The Wayfarers’ Session Zero has concluded. Thank you Sinopa, Valjan, and Gundath for making it on such short notice –– I’m definitely looking forward to roleplaying with you over the beta and through into the launch. You brought many important questions and concerns with you as well as an interest in our roleplay, for which I’m very thankful. For all those who missed it, a full write-up of what was discussed can be found below.

 **Rolling for Initiative**
I proposed the idea of some kind of /roll system for events, with the possibility of having character sheets and modifiers in true D&D style. Using /roll was overwhelmingly approved of by all members present, and there was support for creating a more specialised system on top of that for use in events, so long as it was simple and streamlined.

There is no system at present, but I’ll be starting work on one ASAP. It will likely involve racial traits and role traits (healer, tank, damage dealer) to better customise your character.

 **Wibbly-Wobbly, Timey-Wimey Stuff**
The members who turned up today are from an eclectic mix of timezones. We had two from EST, one from MST, and all alone in the Euro-corner, myself, in GMT+1.

We also discussed everyone’s preferred days of activity (for DM’d events). This has resulted in (tentatively) running events on Tuesdays and Fridays, at 6:30PM EST. These events will be scheduled at least three days ahead of time for people to say whether or not they’re attending.

 **The Heroes’ Journey**
One thing promised to all members who join the guild and stick with us for roleplaying is the idea of personalised quest lines. Like any good DM, you can send me a private message if you’d like something to eventually be set up pertaining to your character’s background: an old enemy showing up out of the blue, family members in danger, etc. I am more than happy to set this up in a proper storyline.

Similarly, we discussed dungeon-crawling and what that means in-character. Any dungeons cleared will be considered an IC achievement, something to reference properly. To avoid situations like, ‘Yeah, we totally killed Lich King,’ it will be referred to in more vague terms. For example, when we run through Wailing Caverns, we will be clearing it of ‘druids of the fang’ rather than Cobrahn, Anacondra, etc., avoiding mentioning named NPCs.

 **A Home of Our Own**
While we are a nomadic guild, the question was raised as to whether or not we would have a headquarters in the world. The Wayfarers will be travelling from zone to zone, setting up camp in scenic locations (outside of the main hubs), but due to popular demand we will have a base in one of the cities.

Where exactly that is, however, is up to you guys. Send screenshots of quiet places in Orgrimmar or Thunder Bluff as suggestions. We will be starting in Razor Hill and moving rather quickly into the more dangerous Barrens upon official launch of the server, so we may not see it until we double-back later on.

 **Discord**
We have a Discord for the guild now, which is seriously bare bones (and won’t be updated until tomorrow afternoon) but if you would like an invite, you can DM me. My contact information is in the first post in this thread.

This is all very exciting. Looking forward to seeing what stories we can make together!

author: Menareth
subject: <The Ashen Vanguard> is seeking signatures!
content_md:
Well met, Stranger!

Long-time RPer and WoW player here. Posting this in an effort to try and touch base with folks through this forum in order to slowly begin recruitment for my RP guild-to-be.

I've been roleplaying through various mediums (D&D, Edge of the Empire, Mage: The Ascension, Vampire: The Masquerade, to name a few) and spent eight wonderful years on Moonguard, US-side. I've met some absolutely wonderful RPers, and had some truly memorable moments through interactions with people and characters from all walks of life.

Now that I am more used to the lore and game, I've decided to form a guild focused on roleplaying, but through which we can also hit dungeons, quests, etc., either IC or OOC. Though I am new to the server and currently leveling my main, and am more familiar with Alliance, I would be looking for characters of any race or class to join with Amren Menareth in forming The Ashen Vanguard.

For a bit of background, The Ashen Vanguard was a mercenary company formed on a temporary basis to tackle jobs in various locations along the Kingdoms that were, at the time, considered too difficult by some to tackle individually. They remained together for a time, until personal desires and goals caused the company to splinter. Menareth, the company Commander, recognizes the utility of such a group, and has, after a few years working alone, decided to recruit anew.

If there are any Alliance RP enthusiasts out there desiring to join a guild with an IC focus, but that will also help to accomplish questing and dungeon goals either IC or OOC (and perhaps even be a social guild), then feel free to message me so we can set up a meet. If by chance I am not online when you seek me out, feel free to add me or send me an IC letter!

author: Cael
subject: <The Greysteel Company> Crossfaction RP Guild
content_md:
![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/579625883388870656/579626440350236682/Blackmoore_poster.png)

 **<The Greysteel Company>**

Hello everyone! I am pleased to announce officially on the forums that, <The Greysteel Company> is recruiting and actively seeking out new members!

Do you Role Play? Are you searching for a community of like-minded individuals to RP with? Is your character in need of work? Or, on the other side, does your character have work to give? The Greysteel Company is open to any type of character. One can ICly join the company, or they can be a contract/ally of the guild.

You do NOT have to be a "adventurer" kind of character. The premise of the guild is that we will take any and all jobs that come our way. Even it it's as simple as - collecting ingredients for some kind of *ahem* stew. Or taking a book all the way to Menethil Harbor! Of course there will always be your, rescue the damsel, kill the enemy kind of jobs.

That's where you come in! We have dedicated officers who are more than willing to build story content for the guild and progress - but the most fun we've had is when others bring forth their own ideas and events to the guild.

The best part about it is, because we're a work for contract premise - we have just about good reason to be anywhere in Azeroth! We even turned a suicide run through Orgrimmar just to run Ragefire Chasm into a IC mission to rescue an elf from deep within the bowels of the Horde City. That person then decided to join the guild to keep the RP going!

We encourage new and old RPers alike. We're a very friendly and welcoming guild. Conflicts are few and far between, and members are encouraged to bring up any concerns or questions to the officers/leadership of the guild.

Our most active time is during the weekends, usually around 10am PST. We have members in the guild from all over the world, a healthy European population as well as American. We try to have an official RP event at least once a week. The goal is to get RP flowing pretty consistently and having members RP during down time between guild events!

Ashlynn and Blackmoore co-lead the guild. With Talvik being second in command. You can message them in game for any questions/comments/concerns.

 **Discord names:**
@Caelinmarie#3616  @Spades#6557 @Kuba15100#2960

Any member that is above entry level can send a guild invite.

author: Thiccroy
subject: <THE RED FIST> [Non Hirearchal, Stromgarde RP, Alliance Only]
content_md:
**"Esarus thar no'Darador.**
 *By Blood and Honor, We Serve."*
 - Old Stromic (Ancient Common) vow used by the Knights of the Kingdom of Arathor, later Stromgarde.

THE RED FIST

![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/466627246212251698/594948722954076191/1523317328630.png)

 **THE LORE**

Ten years ago, during the Third War, Stromgarde fell as the last line of fully organized Human resistance against the Scourge. Its fall is attributed to the Alteraci Syndicate, invading Ogres and Trolls, as well as the prior mentioned Scourge. Its people scattered to the south and all vowed to return to their lawful land, to take it back with Blood and Honor.

It would come now. Ten years later, a young man of Noble blood has grown into a capable warrior, and with his amassed wealth through various adventures and contracts, has sent out letters-

A Call to Arms has been sent out! It is as follows:
People of the Alliance. Heroes. Adventurers. Mercenaries. Knights. Wanderers.

We have sat idle as the dead and the Horde with them have scrounged around our ancient sites of greatness and glory. Where duty and honor were law, and where Kings ruled with kindness and justice.

Not anymore.

We squabble about in the south, using our skills for naught. The war is in a stand still. It is time we changed it.

The RED FIST shall rise and deliver a blow that the Undead of the Horde shall shy and fear away from when it rises again! I, Dolokhov Steelblood, last of my line, call you now with this vow!

We swore we would return.
Let us repay this vow.

 **THE GUILD**

The Guild will work as so:
 -No Hierarchy at all. The Guildmaster is OOC, and every man, IC, and OOC, is equal in footing.
 -IC decisions considering the Guild and any entries into it by other characters will be considered in a vote.
 -This will be an RP PvE Guild, but if Horde players are seen by the Red Fist, they will either be captured or killed on sight.

What you'll get out of this:
 -A fun but also serious RP community
 -Character progression and recognition
 -War, blood, glory, loot, and honor
 -STROMGARDE

 **JOIN NOW!**

Edward Longshank age 10 submitted to being an orphan, however he wasn't the nicest of people going around the streets starting small with pick pocketing and petty thief among city shop's, however he did have a soft spot for Orphan's and helped out the best he could with small donation's he gotten form thiefing. However actions have consequences from his bad humour and vile human be behaviour he never did find a familt to adopted him.-

Many years go by and he hit's the age of 18 he is now legaly a man, he was kicked out of the orphanage with a set last name and afew others the same age as him, they all are named "longshank" Edward knows the streets and know's how to make easy money however now he wanted to hit it big! He convinced the other orphans, well some of them to team up with Edward being all in the same boat homless without a family.. - He gave a heart warming speach on the lines of "'Ey, ey listen up, those cunts didn't give us a family, so let's make our own and call ourself's, The Longshanks Family" Atfer some hard hug's the new former gang has been made and the team set off with adventures of thiefing and robbing.

Many years have gone afew of The Longshanks Family have been arrested due to petty thief, aswell murder. Edward is trying to comeup with a plan for the gang atfer the missing crew-men. - However Suddenly a Nobel steps forword at the bar looking at the group smileing.  (At this point the gang i semi known, however they havn't gotten so big yet) The Nobel try's to shake eveyones hand however they give back a dirty look, Edward cut's to the chace and questions why the nobel man came forword to such lowlifes. - The Nobel give's the group his name with a speach- "Ahem, sorry for interrupting my name is Pile Gumas I serve under the knight himself, I'm what you call a nobel. " Atfer he said this the Longshanks look at each other worryed, some speak about pick pocking the nobel, however Edward just stares with a flat stun look "I heared about Robby Rodent and your friend called Steven Stern." Atfer he speaks of these names the groups seem to look upset and annoyed, they seem to possbley kill the nobel, however they are in the public eye. "And I'm here to aid you, you all infact. You see I once was an orphan such as most of you lot here, and I was given a chance to prove myself to the king himself. I started off low cleaning spit pot's and cleaning knights armour and boot's, now I'm helping with tax credit's and house placement in the city.-" Edward Suddenly cuts in "Hurry up chump, we aint got all fuckin' day do we boys?!" The rest of his crew dosn't seem to reply to shitty however they seem to listen to the nobel. - The Nobel carrys on "Well I'm here to look for more hand's, I'm seeking more replacements for cleaner's and kitchen staff." Edward Stands up slaming his hands on the table, as he dose this the nobel stands up placieng his fingers on the hilt of his sword.. Edward loudly speaks "You aint taking any of me crew, they are strong and loyal! Aswell we got sum boy's to break out of the Stock's, so..- If you don't fuckin' mind do one." The Nobel shakes his head and speaks out with a playfull tone "Hahaa.. Mr Longshank I'm here to offer warm bed's a home for life, and mabye a job for life, if anyone wants to come with me please do." He Suddenly turns and walks to the door slowly.- Whlie this happens the group seems to look at one another, one of the longshanks run at the nobel with two more leaving. - Suddenly only one is left he hugg's Edward and say's "Good luck older brother." As this happen's Shitty is telling them to stop, don't go it's a trap! However they all leave him. That night he drank himself to forget what the nobel's have done, ploting for what come's never however..-

Many years latter and Edward seem's to be loseing his mind due to mixxing odd toxic mixes into deadly durg like potion's with "snuff" and among other crap. - Afew afew harden long years of self abuse and drug abuse he's seemed to be a whole new person, one with nothing but hate and anrger towards the nobel heads of the city. - However he's gotten abit bigger now.

After much longer now, about twenty year's have gone past and Edward seem's to have forgotten his past life due to his toxic brew potion's he likes to down on a daily bases, people on the streets call him "Shitty Scab" however his "friends" call him Uncle Pop's. He has just gotten out of the Stockade for the second time looking for people to start his new crew. -

Thanks for reading! This is just a short part of shitty's life, I missed alot out like how he was in the Stockade the frist place! However I just wanna explain what he's like and his back story. Please let me know if you do wanna make this crew, I'm egar to find some cool new roleplaye!

author: Romanov131
subject: <The Scarlet Crusade> | Hardcore Roleplaying Guild
content_md:
> "'Can you not see it, brothers and sisters? There is but one way to wipe the Scourge from the face of Azeroth. The Scarlet Crusade offers you the protection that you so desperately desire, and if you will pledge yourself to us, surely we will reach our ultimate goal. Defy us, and you will be dispatched in a blaze of golden light unlike any you have ever witnessed."'
>  Scarlet Commander Mograine

![Image](https://i.ibb.co/b6pXkwc/Rck5bgZ.png)
![Image](https://i.ibb.co/Zg09wzs/jAY9JJQ.png)
![Image](https://i.ibb.co/b6pXkwc/Rck5bgZ.png)
![Image](https://i.ibb.co/HN8XNXr/sm.png)

To the far north of the human kingdoms stands an isolated order, one dedicated to the eradication of all unliving and those who support or tolerate them.
It’s members, trying to reclaim what is rightfully theirs, constantly face unspeakable horrors. Wading into battle with zealous fervor, slashing and hacking until they either fall or vanquish all enemies. Abandoned by their allies, with sole faith in the Light left in their hearts, with a purpose of avenging their families and cleansing the taint of undead.
People call them madmen, zealots and traitors without realizing that they are the last bastion of humanity in these forsaken lands. Those who oppose them or dare set foot in their holy sites shall be purged without hesitation as impure.

For the Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from Lordaeron.

![Image](https://i.ibb.co/5M0L3FQ/Rec-3.png)
![Image](https://i.ibb.co/b6pXkwc/Rck5bgZ.png)
The guild is focused around the events involving the Scarlet Crusade in it's current state in the classic timeline.
People who want to join must take into consideration few things:

The Crusade is **NOT** some purified version of itself without the corrupt leaders/dreadlord or any other fantasy similar to that. It is as evil, fanatical and misunderstood as it is described in the game or the comics, keeping it as close to lore in Classic as possible.
Those who join are encouraged to start leveling their human characters in the northern parts of the Eastern Kingdoms, namely Tirisfal Glades, as true descendants of **Lordaeron**.
Roleplay events are to be held in Lordaeron areas only /Tirisfal Glades, Hillsbrad Foothills and The Plaguelands/ with major RP hubs as Scarlet Monastery, Hearthglen and Tyr's Hand. Roleplaying in major Alliance cities is forbidden and those who refuse to accept that will be expelled.

 ***Requirements:***
 **Race**: Human character (only human characters will be allowed in the Crusade with no exceptions);
 **Classes**: All classes /Warlocks and Shadow Priests are not to use shadow spells while roleplaying/;
 **Dedication**: All initiates must have a reasonable cause to join and then prove it in battle against both Scourge and Forsaken forces;
 **Ties to the Alliance**: The Church of the Holy Light has branded the Scarlet faith as heretical and currently the Alliance broke all ties with the Scarlet Crusade. The Alliance is constantly sending assassins to murder officials of the Crusade and is considered by our members as an act of war.
Humans who approach should be viewed with suspicion of being infected by the Plague while other races must be engaged on sight.
Cities like *Stormwind* and *Ironforge* are **NOT** to be visited without hiding your identity of being part of the Crusade(without wearing Scarlet tabard or armor);
 **Dress code**: All members are required to wear red-colored gear suitable to the Scarlet Crusade when in Lordaeron at **all the time** – while doing events or while leveling in Tirisfal Glades/Plaguelands. ![Image](https://i.ibb.co/b6pXkwc/Rck5bgZ.png)
The Scarlet Crusade hunt the undead in Lordaeron with a frightening zeal. They commonly attack the living who wander too close to their holdings.  These paladins have a frightening policy: When in doubt, assume the worst. Many innocent mortals have been killed through misunderstandings, or simply for good measure. Those who question their leaders or policies are assumed to be undead sympathizers and are slain. While the Alliance is in agreement that the Scourge needs to be eradicated from Lordaeron so they can return home, few Alliance members would agree with the methods used by the Scarlet Crusade.  They are the natural enemies of the Scourge and the Forsaken, but they have made themselves the enemy of any who cannot quickly and definitively prove their mortality.

![Image](https://i.ibb.co/dG4s26h/Tyr-s.png)

 **For more information or invite ingame you can contact:**
High Protector Gavinrad
Grand Inquisitor Isillien
Lieutenant Lacaya
Lieutenant  Darkel

author: Breidr
subject: Re: <The Scarlet Crusade> | Hardcore Roleplaying Guild
content_md:
Hey there, very interested in something like this.  I used to really into reenacting, but with my disabilities worsening I've had to take on a less active role. They didn't let me off easy, as I'm still an NCO, but my field command days are over.

I've been looking for a way to fill the void, and after burning out on "milsim" because of.... Reasons. I've gotten dragged into roleplay by a few friends. First time playing 5e and my character is a mess, but I'm trying, I swear!

I was thinking something like this might fit the two together, and get me a social outlet, as well as some of that "reenactment" feel that I've been missing.

The part I seem to struggle with is differentiating my character from myself. Not to say it's a self insert, but I tend to treat them more of a game piece and struggle a bit. My Dwarf has turned into a grumpy piece of sh*t and that was not the direction I saw coming, considering I had none to begin with, which is probably making every experienced RPer in here shout "oh no."

I don't want to be a burden on the guild, so I wanted to leave a post here to start, rather than go right to discord. I'm in there currently reading the FAQs and guides.

The character I plan on making will be "slow and steady" with War Mode on if that changes anything. Very curious how to get to Lordaeron and do the leveling there.

Being human narrows the class choice down a bit. Really trying to do my research to find a low skill floor class. I'm not concerned about it being too "easy" as some would complain. Hell, if my class played itself I'd be happy, as I could focus on other things! (In the game, of course)

Hoping to hear from you, whether I join or not. Thanks for the consideration.

author: Naito
subject: ------{The Knights Templar}------ Leveling/Casual/TightKnitCommunity/RP Guild.
content_md:
At the heart of Deadwind Pass, beside the terrible tower remnant of Karazhan lays a small, somewhat untidy, but very homey church. From this church, liberally infused with the holy light and the strong final hopes and wishes and desires of the many who fell to the darkness of Karazhan. The order of The Knights Templar is housed.

The church is small, but well stocked with provisions to do battle with the corruptions of our world. It may cost a bit to fully equip yourself with the arms and armor that identify you as a proper Knight in this unfeeling world, but despair not, there are those much higher within the order that will assist you in financing your preparations.

The order grows day by day, some come seeking to purify the lands of the darkness and we plot with them how best such activities can be accomplished.

Others seek power, wishing to quickly grow strong enough to stand stably within this dangerous world. There is strength in numbers, and often those who come in search of power band together with multiple fellow Knights whom are of similar strength and venture forth into the darkness of dungeons to gain power by rooting out the corruptions within.

Some seek community, wishing to bear fellowship with their fellow order members. As they become part of the order, they will never be alone. Without regard to time of day or night, there are almost always several or even many order members to enjoy talking with.

We have great aspirations, our eye lays upon the deepest and darkest regions in Azeroth. Where sleeping dragons plot our destruction, where fire, sand, ice and the filth of undeath corrupts our world. We aspire to one day have the strength and numbers to crush these places, even without relying on outside forces to assist. But we will never obsess over them.

Our first priority is to our fellow members, for we may only grow strong enough if we stand together.

Over 300 aspirants have joined the order, you will find us adventuring all over the lands of Azeroth, any race, any class is welcome without regard to faction so long as you have a friendly attitude are willing to learn and wish to be a part of something greater. Our mission to bring hope once again to Azeroth is more important that rivalries between Kings and Warchiefs.

If this has sounded like the companionship you have searched for on your journey in Azeroth, then strike now, the time is ripe. We are almost always easily found within the world, just get in touch with a member today to join us. The world communication channel might suffice, but if not you can directly speak to any member you see who can begin the process of bringing you into the fold.

Be welcome fellow Knight aspirants!

By the Light!
 -Knight Soryen.

content_md:
Ohh, Skullmiser, I'm not certain what happened between you and Aurrius--and it is none of my business either--but, while he does indeed lack manners here and there, he does have good qualities too.

When I came to Turtle-WoW he was literally one of the first people I encountered--it was while he was on his alt Gavinrad though mind you--and straight away he was friendly and eager to party up to accomplish tasks; and frankly, that is something that I initially saw a severe lack of. This game can be daunting, and it's nice when someone pops up out of nowhere offering you aid when you really need it.

Over the course of my travels in Azeroth I kept running into people within the Knights, and they were of the extreme few I encountered that were willing to help me in my endeavors. I often found myself grouped up with them for dungeons more than any other guild folk I'd encountered, and they were all friendly and capable, and we accomplished what we set out to do. That resonated with me--a friendliness, resourcefulness and willing attitude to help--and it's what got me considering asking to become a member eventually.

There are a lot of good folk in our guild, and while the not-so-favorable attributes of one member sullies the entirety of our rank and file for some, it does not diminish the fact that we do indeed have good people in our midst at all. No one is perfect--I have a very foul mouth myself--but I'm not going to let shortcomings of personality keep me from meaningful interactions and progression.

It's a good guild, and I'm hopeful for its future because we have many-many capable folk in it. It's not perfect, it could be better, but that's a statement that can be applied to most things and people--only time and effort will make it more than it is today.

Irregardless of how you feel of Aurrius, or our guild, I have no issue with you personally. I thought you were very nice from our interaction in BRD, and I appreciate you taking the time to come and help with the run--goodness knows Sory and I needed it. Hopefully we'll have more amicable interactions in the future that will be of benefit to us all. Take care.

 -- Much love, Gracemourn <3

P.S.

Oh, and Sory, that was indeed a good post; you do write very well--good job! <3

author: Sheila
subject: [NEW] Blue Anchor Exports (RP Guild)
content_md:
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/Ib5SELO.png)
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/gdqMh9r.png)
 **Blue Anchor Exports**

Blue Anchor Exports is a trading company based in Theramore Isle that pursues various business ventures.

The company started as a small group of hard working friends running a tavern which is now the location they base their operations, brewing their own special ales and meads offering an appeasing selection of beverages to their guests, and clean, comfortable bedrooms are kept maintained offering a place for a good night's rest for weary travellers of all kinds.

The companies reputation grew fast, as did the amount of gold coins they would collect in their vault. The group with their new acquired wealth decided to broaden their means of trading, shipping their beverages to various ports around Azeroth where they would be brought to and sold in other taverns. As their reputation continued to grow, so did their methods of trading, and the demand for shipments were at an all time high. The company saw this as opportunity to venture out even further into the world of trading.

Trade routes from the docks have enabled the company to trade goods of all kinds between the ports of Kalimdor and Azeroth, trading with other companies, settlements, outposts, and the occasional lone traders and collectors. With measures in place to ensure that goods reach their destination safely and efficiently, the company strives to build and maintain relations with other merchant-types and to establish more trade routes around Azeroth, and to eventually open new trading hubs in the attempt to heighten, solidify, and necessitate their economic presence.

![Image](https://i.imgur.com/gdqMh9r.png)
 **The Blue Anchor Tavern**

The Blue Anchor tavern is located in the northern part of the Alliance port-town, Theramore, opposite the famous Theramore Keep and at the foot of the great tower that overlooks the isle. It's known for it's various home brewed beverages, and exotic beverages that arrive to the tavern in shipments from other ports around Azeroth.

![Image](https://i.imgur.com/yqwwDG2.png)

> *"Great service, above-par food, and to-die-for mead! I question why you wouldn't want to visit The Blue Anchor. A good buddy o' mine told me about it last week, and I could scarcely believe him. He said that the employees were warm and friendly. What would I rate it? Easily a nine out of ten!"*

> *"I haven't seen many taverns as class as this one. I would agree with most people that she runs a business as honest as herself. The food is good, hell, I've helped prepare it a few times. The drinks are well-brewed, and the service is excellent!"*

![Image](https://i.imgur.com/gdqMh9r.png)
content_html:
Blue Anchor Exports

Blue Anchor Exports is a trading company based in Theramore Isle that pursues various business ventures.

The company started as a small group of hard working friends running a tavern which is now the location they base their operations, brewing their own special ales and meads offering an appeasing selection of beverages to their guests, and clean, comfortable bedrooms are kept maintained offering a place for a good night's rest for weary travellers of all kinds.

The companies reputation grew fast, as did the amount of gold coins they would collect in their vault. The group with their new acquired wealth decided to broaden their means of trading, shipping their beverages to various ports around Azeroth where they would be brought to and sold in other taverns. As their reputation continued to grow, so did their methods of trading, and the demand for shipments were at an all time high. The company saw this as opportunity to venture out even further into the world of trading.

Trade routes from the docks have enabled the company to trade goods of all kinds between the ports of Kalimdor and Azeroth, trading with other companies, settlements, outposts, and the occasional lone traders and collectors. With measures in place to ensure that goods reach their destination safely and efficiently, the company strives to build and maintain relations with other merchant-types and to establish more trade routes around Azeroth, and to eventually open new trading hubs in the attempt to heighten, solidify, and necessitate their economic presence.

The Blue Anchor Tavern

The Blue Anchor tavern is located in the northern part of the Alliance port-town, Theramore, opposite the famous Theramore Keep and at the foot of the great tower that overlooks the isle. It's known for it's various home brewed beverages, and exotic beverages that arrive to the tavern in shipments from other ports around Azeroth.

"Great service, above-par food, and to-die-for mead! I question why you wouldn't want to visit The Blue Anchor. A good buddy o' mine told me about it last week, and I could scarcely believe him. He said that the employees were warm and friendly. What would I rate it? Easily a nine out of ten!"
"I haven't seen many taverns as class as this one. The owner, Miss Santiago, offers a wide variety of beverages like I've never tasted before; exotic brews, meads, ales, whiskeys, rums, lagers, draughts, wines, it's almost breathtaking, and I'll be damned if the service and atmosphere wasn't top-notch! I will definitely be visiting the Blue Anchor again on my travels."
"Hah, I've known the owner of this tavern for twenty damned years, so I suppose I'm a tad biased. Shei, Sheila, whatever you want to call her owns this place. I would agree with most people that she runs a business as honest as herself. The food is good, hell, I've helped prepare it a few times. The drinks are well-brewed, and the service is excellent!"

author: Sheila
subject: Blue Anchor Exports (OOC)
content_md:
**OOC Information**

First and foremost, this is a guild dedicated to the creation of safe civilian RP that will be actively RPing through casual encounters and both improvised and organized events. Not only that, but we will endeavour to bring RP to the western continent and the various port towns around Azeroth. You, the player, will have an opportunity to build an interesting story for your character within the guild and to be a part of a greater story that will develop as we progress on our journey.

As a business, The Blue Anchor will partake in various trade ventures and merchandising efforts, preferably with actual guilds. Employees will be paid, promoted, or fired, based on their actions and length of time with the guild. In addition to this, professions will play a pivotal role in the success of this guild; for example, we may have a blacksmith create weapons for our henchmen which will help to maintain the peace in the areas we operate and will also travel with our valuable shipments to ensure they reach their destination safely, or we may have engineers that maintain our tavern's equipment, and hunters and gatherers to go out to brave the wilds in order to bring back food and supplies necessary to the continuation of the business. There will also be opportunities for the sell-sword types to work for us time-to-time for various operations.

While the majority of our work would revolve around sales through the Inn and trading, we will have a small amount of highly controlled criminal activities such as smuggling illegal wares and other things you can find out about through RP if your character has earned the trust to be shown these operations. We won't ever hassle players in ways they would be at a loss and will do our best to give players a good experience when RPing with our guild. OOC communication for even tminor criminal encounters would be at an extremely high quality from us and will never be forced upon you, unless of course we are forced by your actions.

If you are interested in joining the guild, please feel free to privately message me here, on discord (Sheila in the Turtle Discord server), or you can message me ICly through the in-game mail system, find my character ICly or OOCly contact me via /whisper, on the character named Sheila. We also have a guild discord server we will invite our members to join.

 **Recruitment**

We are currently recruiting for core members and preparing to establish ourselves ICly. We won't be actively RPing until we have a good handful of solid, active members. Currently, we would like to focus on filling the main positions for the guild, but we're open to new ideas of other job roles as long as they make sense and fit the concept. The tavern positions will be strictly for Alliance characters but we are open to recruit Horde characters for our various trading operations.

 **May the stars guide you!**

author: Tsonev
subject: < Stromgarde Brigade > is recruiting!
content_md:
*As you glance upon the notice board a withered, old piece of paper catches your glance. Loosely nailed to the wood, although aged with yellow sides and crumpled corners, the ink on it looks fresh and still rich of color. Your hand moves, as if magically pulled toward the note, the logo of the fallen city Stromgarde lights up in golden hues by the sun. With your heart beating strong in your chest, eyes darting over the text and hands shaking from excitement you read the finely written announcement:*

Join the Stromgarde Brigade!

The Brigade is looking for brave men and women alike to turn the odds in our favor and claim this great city back from the grasp of the vile Syndicate!

Our allies have abandoned us, the filthy Syndicate and the barbaric ogres have infiltrated Stromgarde. Once one of the most powerful kingdoms, now little more than a battlefield covered with the bodies of our brothers and sisters, we shall not stand for this.  The war may have slowed us down, but it will not slow down our spirits. The spirits to fight, to stand tall in the face of danger, to survive in the direst of moments! Let’s show them why our color is red as we soak their blood in our uniforms, let’s close our fist as our wounds ache and let us spread our wings to show them that no matter what happens, we will fly high and mighty, squashing anyone that stands against us. Set sail to our base in the Arathi highlands and join our ranks as brethren. Our forces include not only brave warriors and spellcasters, but also builders, craftsmen and medics that aid the soldiers and help for rebuilding our city.

We are warriors, we are family, We. Are. The. Stromgarde Brigade!

![Image](https://img.xooimage.com/files80/8/2/7/fan-art-stromgarde-sublime-33eee7b.png)

 **<Stromgarde Brigade>** is looking for brave soldiers willing to fight for the glory of our fallen kingdom. We are a new Alliance RP leveling guild. We want to gather a friendly group of players interested in Warcraft lore wanting to do both some military and casual RP. We will focus on Alliance kingdoms lore (mainly Stromgarde). All classes and Alliance races are welcome. Message me (**Bozhidar** in game) or any member of the guild that is online for an invite.

Credits to Paarthurnax for helping me for this post!

 **Some OOC:** I originally wanted to create some “old Alliance Seven Kingdoms themed guild” ,but I realized that it is too broad to be successfully implemented( the guild won’t have a real focus). I choose Stromgarde, because the story of the whole kingdom is criminally underrated + it is in the game (unlike other Alliance kingdoms with little to no presence at all). I am very eager to organize some RP events after we gain some presence in the server. I hope to find people who are interested and like the idea of Stromgarde-themed guild. See you in Azeroth!

author: Kalocsa
subject: <Mortal> You think you do but you don't.
content_md:
Here's a story of a troll level 2.

![Image](https://i.imgur.com/hdHTwSX.jpg)

Rakzul, the hunter; decided to go out of the valley of the trials, then fought against a scorpid lvl 6.

He died. Even before reaching the level 3. Rakzul don't care, he's in fact immortal in the game.

But imagine one second if he had only one life in Wow. Could you do better than him?!

RIP in peace Rakzul, First Mortal of Turtle WoW.

 **<Mortal>** is a straight Roleplay Hardcore project.

The spirit is, you have one life. If you die, you delete the character. He is mortal.
The challenge is real, i guess also, people can be attached to their character, even after their death. They'll just be off the guild project, but not rewarded to be mentionned in the wall of the dead.

RULES:

 -You have one life. Every release spirit is definitive.

 -Release spirit cannot be effective for this challenge.

 -Ankhs & Bubble-hearth are allowed. But it will not everytime save you from the death. All errors in mortal mod can be an end of the journey.

 -You cannot get any gold from donators, except from other mortal players.

 -You cannot mail yourself anything. You can only send and receive mail from other mortal players, or even Roleplayers only for RP purpose.

 -No alt-banks are accepted.

 -You are able to use the auction house.

 -You can solo dungeons, or even try with other mortal players.

 -All professions are allowed.

 -All talents are allowed

 -All gear you can craft, buy, or provide by youself is allowed.

 -Grouping out in the open world is forbidden, except for a dual leveling challenge or an elite quest.

 **LEVELING IN DUO SPECIAL RULES:**

 -If someone die, the other must fall on the sword and the run is over.

 -You must not leave the same zone as each other.

The challenge end at level 60, If you reach it you'll be able to say:

"i never died in World of Warcraft!"

Kargoz on YouTube (and a ton of other people) are doing something VERY similar on Classic.

 4a) To party up for a dungeon, you must do it inside the instance, and then disband inside the instance.
 5) PvP deaths do count as deaths. Don't do anything stupid to get yourself flagged, unless you're that much of a masochist.

Just going to edit/paste what I also sent to the Scarlet Crusade.  Horde seem to be the underdogs on this server, and I find this guild interesting:

Hey there, very interested in something like this. I used to really into reenacting, but with my disabilities worsening I've had to take on a less active role. They didn't let me off easy, as I'm still an NCO, but my field command days are over.

I've been looking for a way to fill the void, and after burning out on "milsim" because of.... Reasons. I've gotten dragged into roleplay by a few friends. First time playing 5e and my character is a mess, but I'm trying, I swear!

I was thinking something like this might fit the two together, and get me a social outlet, as well as some of that "reenactment" feel that I've been missing.

The part I seem to struggle with is differentiating my character from myself. Not to say it's a self insert, but I tend to treat them more of a game piece and struggle a bit. My Dwarf has turned into a grumpy piece of sh*t and that was not the direction I saw coming, considering I had none to begin with, which is probably making every experienced RPer in here shout "oh no."

The character I plan on making will be "slow and steady" with War Mode on if that changes anything.  Really trying to do my research to find a low skill floor class. I'm not concerned about it being too "easy" as some would complain. Hell, if my class played itself I'd be happy, as I could focus on other things! (In the game, of course)  Currently leaning towards playing a Forsaken.

Hoping to hear from you, whether I join or not. Thanks for the consideration.

author: Greystone
subject: -Northgrave Company- Serious RP Guild
content_md:
~~~~~*The Northgrave Company of Gilneas~~~~~*
![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/938573624737144874/938574075012472902/gilneas.png)
While King Greymane has walled off the world to Gilneas, some within the country still keep up with the goings on with the world outside. Lord Galician Graveholme has noticed how weak the world outside has become. The Old Alliance is dead and the lion-led successor toils away in the far south, too distracted by their own turmoils to think of the lost lands of Lordaeron. The Scourge has fractured and whatever faction of the soulless undead that have laid claim to the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron are disorganized and not yet established. The Orcish Horde has long departed these lands save for those miserable hermits in the Alterac Mountains. Lordaeron is ripe for conquest and the Northgrave Company is poised to make a *killing*.

Operating out of Gilneas, but with chapter houses across the Eastern Kingdoms the Northgrave Company seeks to profit off the squabbles of the Horde and Alliance. Primarily focused on activities on the continent of Lordaeron, the company dabbles in many schemes across the Eastern Kingdoms.

What the Company looks for in recruits: All but the dead. While Gilneas proper may dislike those who follow the red banner, the Northgrave company sees that some of them can be of use. Money talks and the riches that have been left rotting in the north are many and there is plenty to share.

"The Undead are lost, they may bear the resemblance of family or the shattered memories of those we once loved but they are gone. What remains outside these walls is nothing but the dead and and those that refuse to depart. It is mercy to relieve them of their Light-cursed existence and benevolence to reclaim the lands lost to the Scourge by any means necessary."
 -A Gilnean Priest
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
OOC: The Northgrave Company is a mercenary RP guild on TWoW that allows all but the undead based out of the Walled Nation of Gilneas. They mostly are active in the Eastern Kingdoms and rarely venture to the West. Events will be a mix of mostly serious with some casual events tied in. Once we've established ourselves, we look forward to being friend or enemy of other RP guilds on the server.

How to Join: Respond to an advertisement on the /world channel or message Galician online or find him in the world. We are currently searching for signatures. We are a cross-faction guild and accept all races/classes except for the Undead.

author: Greystone
subject: Re: -Northgrave Company- Serious RP Guild
content_md:
![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/938842383146176643/938901507435290625/Bounty_Board.png)
In every chapterhouse town a Bounty Board can be found. Clients may choose to leave bounties open to anyone or request the aid of a specific chapterhouse. Company Bounties may show up here from time to time as well with targets that may require a team to go forth and defeat it or even just clever exploration. Chapterhouses may compete for bounties if no specific Chapter has been requested.

 **Information**: A living, functional bounty board! The Company Officers and Clients may post bounties here and offer a reward for completing it. Rewards may be supplies, equipment, potions or gold. The targets must be an achievable bounty such as a named monster's defeat such as a rare spawn, quest target, uniquely named character, enemy players, enemy faction NPCs (major lore characters will not be targetable by bounties except in exceedingly rare circumstances), or in the form of items that can be unique to the target such as Stitches' Femur or a rare spawn's unique drop or a set number of items like Large Trophy Paws. Up to 10 Bounties will be offered on the Bounty Board at a time, with the board getting refreshed as story demands or at a two week period. Occasionally a Special Bounty may be posted with a great reward and will be separate from the normal bounties.

 **Bounty Example**:
Bounty Target's Name: Unlucky Deadguy
Client: Vengeful Moneybags
Reason & General Location: Deadguy stole fifteen barrels of bananas and I want his head! I last saw him in Booty Bay skulking around the streets!
Reward: 50 Silver

 **Proof**: In the cases where a target's death is desired, the burden of proof relies on the bounty seeker who must either provide an item unique to the target in the trade window, (usually in the do not trade section) or provide a screenshot with them standing over the corpse. The proof is only accepted if shown to the Client or Company Officer in person, sending a screenshot after the kill will not count. If someone else happens to know of the bounty and takes their own screenshots and shows it to the Client, they too will be eligible for the reward if the actual slayer cannot show proof of their own. (For example, if someone kills Nimar the Slayer he will usually drop Nimar's Tribal Headdress, if someone claims to have killed him, they may be asked to prove it by showing this item.)
 -------------------------------------------
OOC: This here is a server interactive bounty system. It can be used for PVE and PVP, and is player driven. You can access the bounty system on our discord and sign up as a client. Need a bodyguard for an event, look to the Northgraves? That elite ogre bringing you to tears? Hire the Northgraves! They're sure to have a Chapter House near you, unless you live in Kalimdor, and then they have just one.

author: Demray
subject: <Aegis of Mankind>
content_md:
Calling all proud and steadfast men and women of the alliance!

Humanity is in peril! Our borders are constant under siege, our politics are corrupt and our so called allies are incompetent at best, directly disloyal at worst.

If you want something done right, let it be done by a Human.

<Aegis of Mankind> is a RP/PVP human only guild, inspired by the Late and Great, Lord-Baron Othmar Garithos, his vision of a clean and orderly human ruled kingdom guide our path and deeds.

We strive to serve and protect all that is Mankind, through strict tenents and strong faith in the Human Spirit, we are the last bulwark between Man and the perils that threaten our very existence.

The Knight of the Aegis must follow these 3 tenents.

Compassion - To Serve and aid all of Man

Conviction - To Preserve the Human Spirit.

Chivalry - To Defend the honor of Mankind and our civilized culture.

Talk to the Sir Roamin the Paladin, to get more information.

author: Zulnam
subject: Khaz Auxiliary Guard - dwarf/gnome guild
content_md:
*Next to the tavern entrance, a flier on the wall reads*
The **Khaz Auxiliary Guard** calls on all able dwarves and gnomes to sign up and help restore the homeland to it’s former glory! Apply today!

Duties include (but not limited to): maintaining the King’s peace, aiding the good folk of Khaz Modan, securing trade routes and supplies, aiding in exploration and rebuilding the Khaz!

Stable pay and lodging offered. No previous experience necessary.

Apply today!
 *At the bottom of the flier all sorts of contact information can be found. The name **Brockwell** Samson appears*

 ------
OOC:

The Khaz Auxiliary Guard (KAG) is an RP guild with a light military theme and heavy emphasis on the administration of the Khaz Modan region, handling everything from defense, to rebuilding, supplying outposts and villages and ensuring tax customs are being respected and no illegal goods are passing through. Events run by the guild will as such cover a vast area of activities and not be constrained to military activity only.

Our primary areas of RP will be Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, Wetlands, Badlands, Searing Gorge and Blackrock Mountain, although we hope to organize and partake in events in further regions as well, wherever the interests of Ironforge might take us.

Feel free to contact us in-game (whisper Brockwell), on the turtle discord or on our own at: <https://discord.gg/cD5QUzXzEd>

author: Flashwell
subject: <The Venture Company> - Just Business!
content_md:
*A very flashy poster can be spotted at most neutral trading hubs, usually around seedy inns and markets.*

![:gear:](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/2699.svg) **THE VENTURE COMPANY** ![:gear:](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/2699.svg)

 *"Givin' nature a run for its money!"*

 - The Trade Coalition is huge, far-reaching and massively complicated. In addition, numerous other, smaller goblin companies, created and run by entrepreneurs called moguls (the hands of the trade princes) operate throughout Azeroth. Perhaps the most famous of these smaller businesses is the **Venture Company**, founded and ruled by Mogul Razdunk.

 - The Venture Company is known for spearheading the efforts to reestablish trade routes across eastern Azeroth, to connect isolated goblin trading posts. A growing number of shops in Azeroth have signs declaring that they are owned and operated by the "Venture Company," which the proprietors claim is headquartered in a faraway city ruled by goblins.

![:pick:](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/26cf.svg) The illustrious megatherium business colossus is now looking for enterprising individuals to fill positions of:

- **Contracted mercenaries & guards**

- **Tinkerers & researchers**

- **Labourers, craftsmen & strip miners**

- **Magi, warlocks & alchemists**

- **Merchants & pencil pushers**

If you are a man, creature or unaffiliated entity with any set of skills, send an application to
 *404 Shredder St, THE VENTURE COMPANY, Undermine, Kezan.*

Alternatively, contact Taskmaster Powderkeg, Taskmaster Boabby or Executive Skizzle for more.

> OOC:
>
>  The Venture Company is a casual/heavy company-themed RP guild based on the in-game faction of the same name. We provide weekly events, casual roleplay and a welcoming environment for a vast number of character concepts and roleplayers, new and experienced.

- Venture on over to our Discord for more: <https://discord.gg/U2YbRnkChv>

content_md:
**Heart of the Giant**
Final event of 2023.

 *Eight months ago, the Wolfskull Clan under the former Packleader Nodoba entered Ashenvale on a new campaign. Their first stop was the memorial stone for Grom Hellscream. His sacrifice broke the deep roots the blood curse had on orcish kind, and with it a new age of freedom from the strings of demon puppet masters was born. A fitting start for the Wolfskull, who had set about in the shaded forest to bring death to the demonkind that haunt it.*

![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1035952364508676138/1190629327927255060/Monument.png?ex=65a27ef8&is=659009f8&hm=6fb3c835c56e0ce73ceeac1ea2afaea535557d0a4b36bb03cd008c15049983c0&)

Now, eight months later... Untold patches of soil have tasted blood of both demons, of the Horde, and of Alliance foolish enough to step in the way. Leadership passed from one to another. Numbers have swelled to more than three times that of the old days. The largest gathering of the Wolfskull yet set out from their home of Splintertree and struck at Demon Fall Canyon to secure it for a coming caravan of orcs who wished to pay respect to Hellscream’s memorial as a sign of the ending of the year.

The demons were no match. Having grown from a small band of honorable warriors and mystics, the Wolfskull struck the demonic forces like a true strike force. Trolls, tauren, orcs, even a furbolg that had seen the might and honor of the Horde, all were united in purpose, working as one hand to swing a vicious blade.

![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1035952364508676138/1190629444331765760/image.png?ex=65a27f14&is=65900a14&hm=fa6f957715d848425cb1254493d0d401e8362b3bfcb1434c28c1deb17f33fe99&)

 *There at the foot of the memorial did the Wolfskull gather around their Packleader Zorizar. There in front of the stone, the clan’s purpose was restated, and with so many gathered it was an opportunity to grow yet stronger. Two joined the Wolfskull properly as Pups. Four trials were given out to other young Pups of the clan, so that they may soon be called wolves. And one member who had been with the Wolfskull well over a year was given the honored title of Greypelt.*

![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1035952364508676138/1190629524568817694/image.png?ex=65a27f27&is=65900a27&hm=0d9bb2a2648eb712e9ad76f60f9886a7e02280ae3580e4c4e899636f6dc5b548&)

 *A spy was found to be watching the clan. A Blackrock insurgent, a rat from a bygone era, surrounded and trapped. Justice came swiftly in the form of a whistling axe, and the spies head was liberated from his body. He was buried out of the fel tainted land, a small yet necessary consideration that was perhaps more than they deserved.*

![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1035952364508676138/1190629598472437860/image.png?ex=65a27f39&is=65900a39&hm=e4cf04d4c03b6a611e4f7667c3952c5f9ee11b0faa84096acc27cb1ea897a695&)

Know that this banner waves outside the cave of Splintertree Post, the grinning skull laughing in the face of all who would oppose the Wolfskull Clan. Whether they be demons, Alliance, or even those of the Horde.

![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1035952364508676138/1190629696040341554/clanbanner2.png?ex=65a27f50&is=65900a50&hm=beaa8946c32f806fb20a1dbb02f1839a3561bc71fda3eab46950ad60afb741a9&)

The largest gathering of the Wolfskull yet set out from their home of Splintertree and struck at Demon Fall Canyon to secure it for a coming caravan of orcs who wished to pay respect to Hellscream’s memorial as a sign of the ending of the year.

The demons were no match. Having grown from a small band of honorable warriors and mystics, the Wolfskull struck the demonic forces like a true strike force. Trolls, tauren, orcs, even a furbolg that had seen the might and honor of the Horde, all were united in purpose, working as one hand to swing a vicious blade.



There at the foot of the memorial did the Wolfskull gather around their Packleader Zorizar. There in front of the stone, the clan’s purpose was restated, and with so many gathered it was an opportunity to grow yet stronger. Two joined the Wolfskull properly as Pups. author: Houseperenolde
subject: <House Perenolde> Casual RP guild
content_md:
*"Whatever the Kingdom of Alterac may have done it did not deserve to be reduced to ruins by the Alliance. It did not deserve to have its people branded fugitives and driven out by the 'knights' of the Silver Hand. Alterac, one of the seven kingdoms of man. did not deserve any of this. My countrymen, we will retake what is rightful ours. This I swear to you."*
~ Lady Kalimas Perenolde, Address to the Exiles

 **<House Perenolde>** is a casual RP guild focusing on characters connected to the former Kingdom of Alterac.

 **Races:**
All welcome (former Alterac citizens and mercenary forces)

 **Classes:**
All, but Paladins with backstories tying them closely to the Knights of the Silver Hand will only be admitted on a case by case basis (due to their role in the occupation of Alterac)

 **Notable RP Policies:**
 - We have both roleplayers, non-roleplayers. Parallel guild ranks have been added for both groups.
 - RP guild ranks have access to the Officer Chat which has been set aside as an rp channel (through the wonders of magic/engineering techniques long-range communication between all members is possible).
 - New members wishing to have access to rp guild ranks must submit a character profile for the guild website (not required to take part in rp events).

 **OOC History:**
We formed in August 2022 as a friends and family guild. We participated in several RP events put on by the **Northern Kingdoms** alliance of guilds(<https://discord.gg/ygep5PEQSb>) and hosted our own events in January and February 2023. Through much of 2023 the guild was on hiatus as members dealt with real life matters or just became over all too busy. The guild restarted activities in July 2024. In August we held an IC raid on Ravenholdt Manor as well as an IC exploration of the Gilnean zone which culminated in an IC attack on the City of Gilneas. We are a small guild currently recruiting people interested in the lore of Alterac.

 **Contacts:**
Kalimas (House Perenolde)
Gerak (Mercenary Captain)
Reyneld (House Harlow)

Website: <https://kingdom-of-alterac.weebly.com/>
Discord: <https://discord.gg/4X3ae4Ukv8> (Updated Sept. 11th, 2024)

 *The Stormwind City Watch was ostensibly created to protect the people of Stormwind from miscreants, ruffians and villains, and to uphold a semblance of law and order within the fair city. While its founder was eventually found to be corrupt, these ideals are still upheld today - ‘ideal’ being the operative word. Watchmen are now part of the furniture of Stormwind City, and are easily recognised by their distinctive blue uniforms and abundant cynicism.*

[![Image](https://i.ibb.co/Jm9dyYR/AA-ad-size1-2.jpg)](https://imgbb.com/)

> All Watchmen (to a greater or lesser degree) abide by the Book of Laws: Eighth Edition, Watchman’s Manual and, in times of great strife, ‘The Watchman’s Elbow’ - complete with handy visual aids, by the masterful Triss de Lancrét.
>
>  The Three D's are an essential part of a Watchman's everyday life, enforced since the City Watch was founded many years ago. In no order of preference, they are:
>
>  **Discipline**
>
>  Follow orders, and show respect to those above you in rank. If the Drill-Sarge says, "Jump!", you say, "How high?". If the Lieutenant says, "Run!", you say, "Where to?". And if your Captain says, "Pandaren takeaway!", you say, "Sweet chilli or soy?"
>
>  **Dedication**
>
>  Dedicate yourself to your job as a Watchman, to the law and to the City itself. A Watchman may not enjoy being vomited on by a staggering drunk in the Pig and Whistle, but he must certainly dedicate himself to being vomited on effectively.
>
>  **Doliteness**
>
>  Be friendly and polite to the citizens of Stormwind. Any new recruits who question the spelling of 'Doliteness' are bundled into a sack and never heard from again.

[![Image](https://i.ibb.co/4PhCBvC/citywatchline.jpg)](https://imgbb.com/)

>
>  <https://discord.gg/dPHqAuNDv2>
content_html:
STORMWIND CITY WATCH

The Stormwind City Watch was ostensibly created to protect the people of Stormwind from miscreants, ruffians and villains, and to uphold a semblance of law and order within the fair city. While its founder was eventually found to be corrupt, these ideals are still upheld today - ‘ideal’ being the operative word. Watchmen are now part of the furniture of Stormwind City, and are easily recognised by their distinctive blue uniforms and abundant cynicism.


All Watchmen (to a greater or lesser degree) abide by the Book of Laws: Eighth Edition, Watchman’s Manual and, in times of great strife, ‘The Watchman’s Elbow’ - complete with handy visual aids, by the masterful Triss de Lancrét.

The Three D's are an essential part of a Watchman's everyday life, enforced since the City Watch was founded many years ago. In no order of preference, they are:

Discipline

Follow orders, and show respect to those above you in rank. If the Drill-Sarge says, "Jump!", you say, "How high?". If the Lieutenant says, "Run!", you say, "Where to?". And if your Captain says, "Pandaren takeaway!", you say, "Sweet chilli or soy?"

Dedication

Dedicate yourself to your job as a Watchman, to the law and to the City itself. A Watchman may not enjoy being vomited on by a staggering drunk in the Pig and Whistle, but he must certainly dedicate himself to being vomited on effectively.

Doliteness

Be friendly and polite to the citizens of Stormwind. Any new recruits who question the spelling of 'Doliteness' are bundled into a sack and never heard from again.
“Poor saps. They don’t even know what they’re letting ‘emselves in for.”

To apply for a position in the Stormwind City Watch, send an application by post to one of the current recruitment officers, or seek out your nearest Watchman. Please include your full name, previous experience, skills, talents and reason for wishing to join up, you mad bastard. If you manage to impress, you'll be invited to attend an in-person interview, after which you may be offered a job.

subject: <Swords of Lothar>(RP) | Uncle Lothar Needs You!
content_md:
**The Swords of Lothar(RP) | Uncle Lothar Needs You!**
![Image](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1114613646924984481/1114684564984578119/Polish_20230603_153142510.png) **A Letter from the High Marshal**
Good day to you, proud sons and daughters of the Alliance! If you are reading this, then you have considered enlisting in the Swords of Lothar division, and I am more than glad to welcome you in our ranks. I believe that It will suit you best if I'll provide you a short overview of our mission and different goals we are striving to accomplish.
The Swords of Lothar are a division of the Seventh Legion of the Alliance Army, most commonly known as "The Swords". Our main objective is to protect the people of the Alliance where the Army at large can't. To succeed in completing this task, we devote our time to constant training, skills development and gaining new knowledge for us being ready to take up arms when the time comes.
If you are planning to be a capable and contributing member of our order you should always be prepared for you will face many hardships as a loyal servant of the Alliance. I salute your bravery and resolve if you are ready for the trials ahead and wish you best of luck. May the odds be in your favor and may the Light guide your path.
 **-Koldin Gaidlick, High Marshal of the Swords of Lothar** **Azeroth, Our Home**
 *For thousands of years Azeroth has been the birthplace and home to many different races of the Alliance. We've flourished and gotten stronger in this world, facing various hardships and losses that appeared through the past centuries. Today our duty, our obligation and our oath as children of Azeroth is to protect its lands from whomever might try to harm them in any way. And we will do just that, standing proudly together, ready as one to sacrifice our lives for this nouble cause, for the well being of our land.* **Threats To The Alliance**
As a division of the Army, we are sworn to confront all the possible threats to the Alliance that may arise. It doesn't matter if our adversaries are petty crooks or Horde Warlords, all of them are our enemies and we must put an end to their atrocities.
Here I would like to give a brief overview of the main directions of conducting our military operations, depending on the region of deployment of enemy forces.
Our main enemies in the South are the so-called "Defias Brotherhood", a group of merciless bandits and ruffians that had overrun some of the important provinces of the Kingdom of Stormwind. These criminals and traitors should be brought to justice, or taken to the Stockade in the city of Stormwind for further interrogation, if they are suspected to hold a valuable information which can be crucial for our efforts against the enemy.
Another threat in this domain is the Horde, having many bases of operation in the southern regions of the Eastern Kingdoms. These murderous beasts possess a significant menace for our lands and the overall well-being of the citizens of the Allaince. In this case they must be intercepted at first sight and dealt with, for the end must be put to the their harmful deed and their wicked ways.
Our main adversary in the North are the Scourge and Forsaken that have wiped out the Kingdom of Lordaeron in the past years. These disgusting enemies of all living things pose a constant threat to the northern territories, poisoning the once magnificent forests, fields and hills of this region with their vile presence. Being abominations of the dark, they are extremely dangerous and should not be underestimated. A soldier is required to have a clear mind and enough training and experience to withstand this enemy.
Some of the other lesser threats in the North to be considered include the Scarlet Crusade, religious zealots that are inclined to kill anything and anyone they deem being corrupted and unpure. **What you can expect from us**
We are a pure roleplaying guild, with the goal of having RP as our first and only priority to live up to the name of an RP-PVE server. Our server has suffered many changes and our experience has shown us that it is now time to passionately stand up for our idea of good roleplay if we want to revive this way of experiencing the game. This idea is based on lore-oriented game and character concepts, consistent roleplaying and a system of rules for fights, which guarantees fun for all participants. Playing easy-D&D in a World of Warcraft setting without having to leave your home?! If that sounds good, the Swords of Lothar might be the perfect fit for you
We host multiple RP events every week, be it the most dangerous fights this side of the Dark Portal, or in front of the cosy fireplaces of our base or while visiting allies. We offer a community that sees roleplaying not just as an accessory or duty, but as something that many of us have come to appreciate and love over the years: Writing history together.

 **For more information about us, you can join our discord or /w Koldin, Karliok, Sheld, Aerybeth or Peregarin in-game**
<https://discord.gg/qvZVUBGHNY>

A blooming hub of RP
[![Image](https://i.ibb.co/sFvK8fB/Screenshot-1.png)](https://ibb.co/MRDcFvX)

 *The bustling marble metropolis, Stormwind City, is considered by many to be the beating heart of the Alliance; populated by Humans, Elves, Dwarves, this thriving melting pot of cultures is home to quest-filled taverns, seedy back alleys and a myriad markets and shops catering to a traveller's every need. Home to all stocks of people, from the most gallant of knights to the most depraved of blackguards, Stormwind truly has something for everyone!*

[![Image](https://i.ibb.co/XpnYGW6/Screenshot-1-1.png)](https://ibb.co/d6NmHfX)

This is a Discord server for people to generate and discover roleplay within Stormwind: if you find you want to establish your character there or if your guild simply roleplays around the city, do join us! Do you want to open a tavern, run a business or even start your own criminal syndicate? This server is the place for you!

> <https://discord.gg/f3pCZgMEDa>

Lastly, don't forget to drop by our bi-weekly events such as the Cathedral bazaars or the gruesome trials!

[![Image](https://i.ibb.co/7YRbNSv/image.png)](https://ibb.co/0DFQVnq)

subject: Andu Falah Dor - Kaldorei Guild
content_md:
**Andu Falah Dor - Let Balance be Restored**

Brother and Sister Kaldorei, let not the darkness of night quench your souls but instead invigorate you with the passion to do what must be done, we are the Children of the Stars! May our light shine forth in the darkest moment to take back our lands and let balance be restored! Anu'dorini Talah!

Let us come together Kaldorei, to restore our people and our lands.

OOC--
A Night Elf Guild- RP -PVE and PVP

We will operate in Night Elf territory with PVE and PVP, even if you don't want to participate in the PVP you can help by making potions, gear, food or just keeping us company. I will organize social and PVE events, if anyone would like to help me run these please volunteer!
I'd like to organize some PVP events with the Wolfskull Clan who also operate in Ashenvale. This is an emerging guild and quite casual (unless lots of people want to join and I need to make it more structured).  My goal is to facilitate casual, balanced and friendly PVP.

You are welcome if you are new or a veteran to RP.  -- Strictly NO ERP--

<https://discord.gg/4atjTQ2Mwh>

 *The Nightsong Sentinels are a legion comprised of a garrison of Ashenvale sentinels as well as their allies. Tasked with keeping the innocents of Kalimdor safe from harm within the Kaldorei regions by General Shandris Feathermoon, they will stop at nothing to ensure the sanctuary that is their forested homes remains unmarred!*

 **OOC:** Only Kaldorei IC can be accepted into the guild, but with sufficient backing all alliance races may join as “diplomats.”

![🌙](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f319.svg)  We currently have over 100+ players in our discord, as well as over 125+ members of our guild! - 3. How Do I join?
![🌙](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f319.svg)  Click the guild discord link, and select the *needs invite* role! We ping it when we log in to alert you for invites.

author: Glados
subject: <The Wrath of the Forsaken> Undead RP-Guild
content_md:
*A poster seen on notice boards in regions, that are now home to the Forsaken.*
> As the people of Lordaeron, we have been terrorized and tormented by the Evil of the Scourge.
>  We have shouldered the ineptitude of a king.
>  We suffered the betrayal of a prince. And at what cost?
>
>  Our homes were taken from us.
>  Our families, friends and allies were taken from us.
>  Our lives were taken from us.
>  Even the peace of our death was taken from us.
>  But no more...
>
>  We are the **Wrath of the Forsaken.**
>  We cannot take back what was lost, but we can take something: Revenge.
>  We pledge to fight the Scourge and destroy the Lich King.
>  We shall use every weapon at our disposal and create new ones if we must.
>  We shall release those brothers and sisters in undeath still trapped in the Scourge's clutches.
>  We will bring devastation to those who maimed, tortured and abused us as their slaves.
>
>  For our rage cannot be contained, and our suffering cannot end, as long as the Lich King reigns.

OOC:
![💀](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f480.svg) The Wrath of the Forsaken is an Undead only RP-guild taking in any undead human that identifies as Forsaken, i.e. those who accept Sylvanas Windrunner as their ruler, as well as any undead human who identifies with their goal of fighting the Scourge.

![📜](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f4dc.svg) We offer an overarching guild plot that provides chances for all kinds of rp, from research and experiments to mercantile and craftsmen and military or combat focused RP. Our goal is to boost and support Horde RP, but Forsaken RP is our main focus.

![⚔️](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/2694.svg) We welcome PvE, PvP and HC players alike as long as they are Undead.

If you are interested in checking us out or even joining, you can find us here: <https://discord.gg/vSkAeUgUrg>
content_html:
A poster seen on notice boards in regions, that are now home to the Forsaken.
As the people of Lordaeron, we have been terrorized and tormented by the Evil of the Scourge.
We have shouldered the ineptitude of a king.
We suffered the betrayal of a prince. And at what cost?

Our homes were taken from us.
Our families, friends and allies were taken from us.
Our lives were taken from us.
Even the peace of our death was taken from us.
But no more...

We are the **Wrath of the Forsaken.**
We cannot take back what was lost, but we can take something: Revenge.
We pledge to fight the Scourge and destroy the Lich King.
We shall use every weapon at our disposal and create new ones if we must.
We shall release those brothers and sisters in undeath still trapped in the Scourge's clutches.
We will bring devastation to those who maimed, tortured and abused us as their slaves.

For our rage cannot be contained, and our suffering cannot end, as long as the Lich King reigns.
OOC:
The Wrath of the Forsaken is an Undead only RP-guild taking in any undead human that identifies as Forsaken, i.e. those who accept Sylvanas Windrunner as their ruler, as well as any undead human who identifies with their goal of fighting the Scourge.

We offer an overarching guild plot that provides chances for all kinds of rp, from research and experiments to mercantile and craftsmen and military or combat focused RP. Our goal is to boost and support Horde RP, but Forsaken RP is our main focus.

We welcome PvE, PvP and HC players alike as long as they are Undead.

If you are interested in checking us out or even joining, you can find us here: https://discord.gg/vSkAeUgUrg
