author: Visionmoon
subject: storybook
content_md:
1. By July 2024, the war between the dwarves of Dun Morogh and the Frostmane Clan was intensifying. The Flashing Gold Town recruitment notice called for participation in the fight against the Frostmane Clan on the Coldridge Trail. With the help of the Paladin Belmany and the Hunter Widgett, they defeated the new recruit, the Frostmane Clan's commander.

 2. Received an order for fur fabrics from the Northshire Abbey. On the way to the abbey, I met the heroes returning from defeating a dragon. As a spellcaster, I sensed an unusual magical aura.

 3. In order to reach the Elven city as quickly as possible, I took the risky decision to traverse the mountain path. According to reports from the sheriff, this area is often plagued by bandits preying on travelers. This time, my adventure didn't reveal any bandits, but I did come across an empty campsite. It seems that taking such risks in the name of adventure does come with its own set of dangers.

 4. Back at the abbey, I didn't follow Reesa's request to throw a copper coin into the pond. I hope she won't be upset; I think such an environmentally harmful act should not be encouraged. And wishing on a common coin probably won't work! It's said that powerful spells can also fulfill wishes; I'll travel with this coin (刵) together.

 5. In Flashing Gold Town, a kind warrior named Jkspark told me the way to the High Elves, saving me a lot of time exploring. Perhaps Reesa's coin does have magic. Just kidding.

 6. It's rumored that there are distinguished High Elven guests in the blacksmith's area of Stormwind City. Maybe I can learn about their customs by investigating first. As it turns out, the High Elves are in great need of supplies, and perhaps I can take some food over. Of course, not because I wanted a snack after receiving a bounty, hehe. I learned powerful and convenient spells from the High Elves and found out about their capital city, <Alterac>. It looks like this will be a wonderful journey. However, I spent the bounty I just received. Waaah!~ I'm eating an apple to calm down, hoping they won't find out I ate some of the food after they accept the order.

 7. Carrying the cargo of the exhausted High Elves, I received an order to deliver to Alterac. The black storms on the Black Coast blocked my journey~~~

 8. I arrived in <Alterac>, this land of flourishing magic, feeling amazed! Here, I learned how to skin and herbology. According to the guards' description, the land to the east still faces the threat of evil. I'll come back here to study when I'm more powerful, and then I can help them resist the evil invasion. I remember learning at the Night Elves' port on the Black Coast that their homeland, Teldrassil, is a very large tree right across the sea. The black storms on the Black Coast blocked the view, and I didn't get a good look at the shadows over there. Perhaps I can adventure there this time.

 9. The books in the Dolanaar Inn made me think about the dark history of Morgan's Grave. In those days, the Scarlet Crusade was born, but who could know the secrets and the Forsaken have a very mysterious connection. Watching the people who don't know arguing, I actually felt excited?

 10. They mentioned the Shadowlands again. They always say that the Shadowlands can rival the Titans. Perhaps the fire of Teldrassil's great fire is as bright as the stars. The souls of the dead have become the energy source that guards the planet. What a tragedy. Born in the Cataclysm at the end of time, the Shadowlands are in turmoil, when will they be stable.

 11. Today, it didn't rain in Teldrassil. Oh~~~ I felt it was very unusual. Lovely Dolanaar!!! Finished! My body is tired, and I don't want to do any quests at all! What a bother!

 12. On the way, I encountered a peculiar creature that resembled a friendly elf and made a strange request. Ugh, I hate troublesome things! Can you believe it? They asked me to deliver an antidote to a male elf! I mean, I can have a boyfriend, too. I detest troublesome things! Hehehe, but this mission comes with emeralds! Gems! I've made up my mind, the gem from this bounty mission belongs to me! No one can snatch it away. I hate troublesome things, sigh~ sigh~ sigh~ Ended up completing this thrilling mission alongside Priest Zasopeca. From my perspective, the connection between the bear-like creatures' uprising and the satyrs shouldn't be significant. A prophecy with golden eyes, a demon hunter? I hope the mastermind behind it isn't using hatred to mislead invading demons. (Obtained a Tiger's Eye gemstone in the lair of Mairenas.)

author: ZararsisRedgrin
subject: Salvagers, Inc - Horde/Neutral Laidback Lair
content_md:
Hi everyone!

New to TurtleWow and to Nordanaar, I am very pleased to announce the creation of a casual RP guild on the Horde side of things, fostered on good mood and laidback plays.

 ****Who we are****
 - Salvagers Inc. is a casual RP guild anchored around a business-oriented sense of adventure.
 - Levelling, PvE (dungeons and raids), PvP and wPvP, RP activities, every aspect of the game we shall treasure, love and value.
 - Relatively new with low members, looking forward to becoming an active part of our community.

 ****The Business****

> "Everyone needs something these days: they've lost a family heirloom, a magic item, a loved one. You never can tell."

Specalized in the acquisiton of lost goods and knowledge, we Salvagers are the Horde's counterpart to the dwarven Reclaimers, except more proactive. Where they comfortably wait for a contract to go after some lost family heirloom, we don't wait for no one to go after Potential Treasure - P.T © - under any of its forms (magic items, rare artefacts, unique reagents or forgotten scrolls) and find ourselves some interested buyers through our network.

> "With the Salvagers around, there's no reason, for the right price, everyone can't find what they need!"

The Salvagers aren't in short supply of work as long as there are perilous sites to salvage. For any looking for a good week's (almost completely) honest work, the Salvagers will have a contract ready, punctuated by myriad of innocent fine prints. Just sign at the bottom of the parchment.

In addition to part-time contractors and full-time adventuring employees, Salvagers Inc. is always on the lookout for business partners all around Azeroth, wherever they might be. Black market liaisons, trading companies and cartel representatives should feel free to leave their cards.

What it means is we're interested in all types of candidacy, all races from both factions! While we would mainly be centred around Horde shenanigans, we maintain contact with people all around Azeroth in the hope of one day benefitting from it.
Additionally, for all RP-groups out there, if you ever need to purchase the services of the Salvagers, let us know - I'm sure we can find a decent price!

 ****Basic Rules****
 - Be a decent being and respectful to one another. No bigotry in the guild will be permitted.
 - Do not take yourself too seriously.
 - This remains a game, and IRL stuff matters! Go easy.

 ****Our (beautiful) discord****
<https://discord.gg/Y62PzE7q>

If you're interested in joining us or merely getting in touch for some laidback fun, feel free to contact Zararsis in game or on our discord!

author: Visionmoon
subject: This leads to the question of why "Queen of the Eternal Winter" Malorne says to "Elune": "How dare you return, my sister
content_md:
Arthas' King Scenario (Diablo Plot):
Knowing the costs incurred by the Tirisgarde Council in defending against the Void, Arthas communicates with his subordinates and willingly descends into becoming the maintainer of a Soul Extraction Machine.

Arthas' Holy Light Scenario (Naaru Plot - the premise is that the group responsible for the Great Cataclysm could not possibly be the Twilight Cult and the Tirisgarde Council):
Arthas' ultimate ability is a mass resurrection. After his troops and subordinates are revived multiple times, the damage to their souls gradually makes them resemble the Undead. Therefore, the situation regarding Arthas' base in Northrend requires further archaeological investigation.

This leads to the question of why "Queen of the Eternal Winter" Malorne says to "Elune": "How dare you return, my sister!" "After so long, you ignored our calls for help and remained indifferent to us."

author: Macaskill
subject: <THE SCARLET CRUSADE> is recruiting!
content_md:
***The Scarlet Crusade: A Legacy Resurrected***

 *Our brotherhood is an ancient project that, over the years, has forged its own history and heritage within the Warcraft universe. Known for its unwavering fervor, the Scarlet Crusade has cleansed its ranks of the demonic yoke following the death of Balnazzar. Now, under the banner of the Church of the Crimson Flame, we return to truly serve the Light, while remaining faithful to our dogmas and forceful methods.*

 **Our New Vision**

•More diplomatic, but without forgetting our fanatical fervor: Although we have opened the doors to dialogue with other factions, we remain a force to be feared for our unwavering determination.

•Strong hierarchical structure:We have various ranks and sections that contemplate different roles (clerics, paladins, knights, explorers, artificers, etc.). Each character can progress in a natural and coherent way, forging their own legend.

•Long-lasting campaigns: We host long-running events and storylines, allowing members to evolve and deepen their stories, earning their place in the chronicles of the Crusade.

 **What do we offer?**

•Quality and fidelity:Our mission is to represent the Scarlet Crusade in all its classic glory, without sacrificing the narrative coherence and rigor that characterizes this legendary faction.
•Serious and professional atmosphere:We take care of every detail of our roleplay—atmosphere, clothing, formations, dialogue—and design events to fully immerse you in the Scarlet experience.
•Realistic progression:Each character advances through the ranks through participation, merit, and loyalty, offering logical and satisfying growth.
•Fraternal community:Despite our harsh methods on the battlefield, within the guild we foster respect, camaraderie, and mutual support.

 **What do we seek?**

•Dedicated roleplayers: Passionate about the Scarlet faction, willing to commit to the narrative and honor the intensity of the order.
•Seriousness and involvement:We want members who take care of the details, actively participate in events, and contribute to the community, both in the story and in the brotherhood.
•Respect and commitment:We need brothers and sisters in arms who strengthen our core with their presence, ideas, and willingness to work as a team.

 **Do you dare to bear the Scarlet Crest of Lordaeron?**

If you feel the call of the Light and the fervor of the Crusade burns in your chest, join us. Here, your steel will forge history and your name will resonate in the chronicles of the order. We do not promise an easy path, but one filled with glory, honor, and unwavering passion.

Contact us for more information and prove yourself worthy of carrying the scarlet banner!

 **The Light guides us and the Crimson Flame purifies us!**

<https://discord.gg/ZvFjEBjRCH>

subject: You spot a [Flyer]
content_md:
The details of the flyer read as follows:

_________________________________

Hello, my name is Vokos.

I'm proud to call myself a Paladin, albeit I'm still learning the ways of the Light. I'm currently looking for work or a company to take part in, as I believe that I've become skilled enough to elevate myself to exterminating threats that could pose greater risk to Azeroth or the Alliance as a whole. I need to detail that my gear is not Ideal, and I'm still ignorant to the greater dangers I may face, but I'm willing to learn their weaknesses. Through continuous trials and greater threats, I hope to improve myself. I'm typically a quiet individual but make up for it through respect for my fellow peers, my manners, politeness, and graciousness.

What I'm looking for is to fight great enemies, camaraderie, and to assist others. Please reach out to me if you find this Flyer appealing. My home is set in Stormwind, but I may be out and about either fishing, mining, or ridding lands of nuisances or other undesirables. If the latter is the case, please feel free to send me a letter in the Stormwind Trade District.

Light bless you and be safe through your journeys.
(Lvl 60 ret paladin, relatively new to the server, looking for an active RP guild that does raiding or PVP. I'm not very experienced in raids, but am willing to learn the fights. I tend to be a little quiet until I get to know people well enough. I'm not very well geared but hope to change that down the road. Please send me a message if you're interested. If I'm not online, AFK, etc, please send me a letter through the mail. IGN is "Vokos".)

___________________________________

EDIT: Thank you to Texas Knights for recruiting me.   happy_turtle_head

author: Brunancio
subject: The MacBrew Clan
content_md:
![Image](https://i.ibb.co/B5KTb02m/foro.png)

> *Unlike their Wildhammer kin who embraced shamanism, the MacBrew Clan learned arcane magic from gnomish exiles - though they insist it was just 'liquid lightning in a bottle.' After being cast out of Aerie Peak for turning gryphon roosts into distilleries, these ale-scholars wandered Azeroth, perfecting two crafts: brewing liquid thunder and bending magic to their drunken will. Now based at Thunderbrew Distillery, they uphold three truths: 1) Any spell improves with ale, 2) All creatures can be sheared or saddled, and 3) The best lightning comes from mages, not clouds. New recruits must swear fealty to barley, bad decisions, and at least one unexplainable explosion per week.*

---
Casual RP/PvE guild for dwarves who believe ale improves everything! We explore iconic dwarf lands (Loch Modan, Dun Morogh, Wetlands, Hinterlands), level together, and turn professions into chaos—especially brewing. Whether questing, crafting, or RPing in Thunderbrew Distillery, we prioritize fun over min-maxing. Weekly activities include drunken dungeon runs, "sheep diplomacy," and tavern tales. All levels welcome—just bring your beard and a thirst for adventure! (Gnomes tolerated if they bring explosives.)

---

> *![Image](https://i.ibb.co/vx3rhRRy/foro1.png)*
>
>  *We roam Azeroth’s dwarf lands (Loch Modan, Wetlands, etc.) in ale-fueled packs, tackling quests with equal parts chaos and camaraderie. Expect shared loot, accidental pulls blamed on "gnome interference," and mandatory tavern debriefs. Whether slaughtering troggs or "liberating" kegs, we prioritize laughs over min-maxing. All levels welcome—just bring a thirst for adventure (and Thunderbrew)  satisfied_turtle_head  .*

 *"...we don’t grind—we ferment."*
![☄️](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/2604.svg) How to Join the MacBrew Clan:
 **IN-CHARACTER:**
Seek out **Breuno** (usually drowning his sorrows at Thunderbrew Distillery or "researching" sheep explosions in Loch Modan). Send a **whisper (/w)** if ye spot me online, or leave a **letter** with my name at any innkeeper's mailbox.
 **LETTER TEMPLATE:** Code: Select all

```
"To Breuno of the MacBrew Clan,
I, [Your Character's Name], seek to pledge my [axe/beard/inexplicable gnomish contraption] to yer warband. Find me at [Location] or expect a drunken gryphon delivery.
Signed, [Your Signature]"
```

 **DISCORD CHANNEL (still WIP)**: <https://discord.gg/8RpgqQPvuf>

author: Piepai69
subject: Taking a Stand Against Racism - The Holy Gnoman Empire
content_md:
It is time to address the most pernicious problem facing our world today, anti-Gnome racism. For generations we've been physically and verbally abused, systematically oppressed, forced into virtual and actual slavery and had our identities erased.

Gnomish poetry is not taught in schools, Gnomish history is unknown, our children grow up accustomed to injustice. When will it end? We ourselves take on the tall man's name, we have forgotten our national dress and pastimes. If they were not so ignorant and vile the tall races would weep at what their hands have wrought.

Yet have hope, brothers and sisters. The Holy Gnoman Empire, which is in no way officially affiliated with the Provisional Freedom Army for Gnomes or the Gnomish Liberation Front is here to give us a united political voice! Membership is open to all adult Gnomes who are willing to take a stand against oppression and want to help us reestablish our homeland and take back our inventions.

There is also room for material donations from non-Gnome sympathizers for our cause!

On **Wednesday 16th at 20:00** we will be having a fundraiser for the charity "Homes for Gnomes" that is working to establish safe spaces for Gnomes in areas like the Barrens and Durotar. Che Gnovara a professor of Gnomish History will be giving a talk titled "The Violence of Non-Violence: Decolonizing Durotar." The event will be in the **Broken Keel Tavern**, Ratchet. The talk will be followed by *refreshments*.

All Gnomes are welcome, for more information feel free to contact our political office.

author: Itsorcalin
subject: Re: Taking a Stand Against Racism - The Holy Gnoman Empire
content_md:
It’s clear most of you people do not understand our plight. But fear not, The Holy Gnoman Empire believes in growth and we’re offering you a chance to start. Read this with an open mind. You might just see things differently by the end.

 **1. Understand That Anti-Gnome Racism Is Real**
The idea that Gnomes are lesser, comic relief, or not to be taken seriously is deeply embedded in Azerothian culture. Treating our struggle as some kind of joke reinforces the idea that Gnomes do not deserve dignity. Denial of the problem is complicity.

 **2. Listen to Gnomes and Believe Their Testimony**
When Gnomes speak about their history, trauma, genocide and exclusion, do not dismiss or minimise it. Don’t centre your discomfort or defensiveness. Listen, learn, and take their words seriously.

 **3. Notice the Ways the World Isn’t Built for Us**
Every bench too high to sit on, every counter we can’t see over, every meeting held in halls where we’re left looking up - it sends a message: *you weren’t considered*. These aren’t just inconveniences. They’re daily reminders that this world was shaped for others, not for us. If you say you stand with Gnomes, then pay attention to how space, access, and visibility are denied to us in quiet, constant ways. Then do something about it.

 **4. Decentre the Tall Races**
Human, Troll, and Orc-centric narratives have been crafted to silence our cause. The Tall Agenda is on repeat, all around us. Mainstream media such as The Everlook Broadcasting Co ignore our calls. Allyship means making room for Gnome voices, perspectives, and contributions. Allow your neighbourhood Gnomes a seat at the table in order to have a platform to educate and spread the good Gnomish word.

 **5. Educate Yourself - Before It's Too Late**
Ignorance isn’t innocent. When you choose not to listen to our testimonies, the weaponisation of radiation against our people, or the ongoing exclusion we face across the world, you're not just avoiding discomfort - you’re feeding a machine that thrives on your silence. The truth is out there, buried beneath years of mockery and literal minimisation. And it will come to light - with or without you. Learn the history. Learn what was done to us. Understand why some Gnomes no longer ask politely to be seen. Because when the reckoning comes, no one will be able to say they weren’t warned.

 **6. Support Gnomish Autonomy**
Let Gnomes lead their own movements. Don’t speak over them, co-opt their struggles, or tokenise them for your own reputation as an “inclusive” person. True allyship supports Gnome-led initiatives and policy making. True allyship supports causes such as Homes for Gnomes (donate today).

 **7. Remember! We Know Who Looked Away**
When discrimination happens, most of you say nothing. The Talls - so quick to lead raids, deliver speeches, and write the histories often grow quiet when it’s about us. You chuckle at the jokes, watch on from behind blue shields as we are picked apart, and act like you didn’t hear what was said in World Chat. But we see you. We've always seen you. Gnomes have long memories, and we’re done pretending that silence from the Elves, the Goblins, the Orcs, is anything but complicity. You stood by while we were colonised and forced into slavery. And we remember. We remember all of it.

 **8. Your Donations Are Not Charity - They Are Accountability**
The Gnomish people have endured displacement, erasure, and exploitation for far too long. When others offer donations - whether resources, aid, or support, it is not a gesture of goodwill or benevolence. These contributions are a debt owed, a reckoning in material form. We do not need pity or empty gestures. We demand reparations that reflect the true cost of our suffering. Your donations are proof of your commitment to justice, or else they are nothing but a reminder that the wounds you helped inflict remain open.

 **9. Break Free from Tall Privilege and the Language of Smallness**
When the infidel city-state of Stormwind built walls and fences to keep Gnomes out while extracting our inventions and labour, it mirrored the segregationist regimes of history - those who divided lands, policed language, and declared entire peoples “less than.” The word “small” is not innocent. It is part of a system. A system of linguistic apartheid that marks us as inferior and keeps us there. The Holy Gnoman Empire sees this clearly. If you keep using their words, you speak with their voice. Break the language. Break the power. Or get out of the way.

 **10. Refuse to Stay Neutral**
In the face of systemic anti-Gnome violence, neutrality is not a virtue - it’s a position of comfort for those unaffected. Sometimes, making a stand requires more than words. Disruption is uncomfortable. Resistance may not be polite. But when structures are built to mock, exclude, or erase Gnomes, it is not enough to merely “hope things get better.” True solidarity demands that we are willing to act - decisively, unapologetically, and with the full weight of our refusal to accept injustice.

author: Awdee
subject: <Keepers of the Void> Light/Medium RP SCP-Like Investigators.
content_md:
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/xvYB52z.png)

 **Keepers of the Void**
A light to medium roleplay guild, who are dedicated to community involvement in roleplay and want to provide a method in which players can be directly involved in a guild’s lore and we intend to incorporate player submissions within the guild lore and create events that both member and non-members can participate in and giving players agency within the guild.

So far, we are small and brand new, but we are ambitious and dedicated. We hope that you will find your place here and share in many exciting adventures.

---
 **Q&A**
- 1.What factions are allowed?
 *Primarily Alliance, though we are not opposed to Horde members. There are no race restrictions.*
- 2. What do you mean by involved?
 *We want you to submit your ideas for lore, story, and roleplay ideas. It could be a quest you're having trouble with or an item you're grinding for. We want to turn that into guild lore.*
- 3. How do you handle roleplay?
 *We are lovers of freeform roleplay, however for structure we will be using a pretty standard d20 system if needed.*

---
The busy streets of Stormwind are awash with sounds even after dusk has settled. Amongst the chaos you hear a whisper, no, a whistle, faint but alluring. Checking your surroundings, vision blurred with pedestrians. But there your ears catch the distinct sound, your eyes see a hooded girl standing in the shadow of an alleyway.

You catch her gaze, and she beckons you closer. The curiosity pulls you closer to the hooded girl. No words are exchanged, just a single white card. It was handed to you blank face up, reversing it, you are greeted by plain black ink: "The Oracle". You look up to ask questions but the hooded girl is gone.

You go about your day. Your weeks. The memory of the hooded girl fades. Until one day you check your mail to find a letter simply addressed "An Invitation from The Oracle". The rest of the invitation is a cryptic mess of jibberish, but you look closer, and see between the lines, you can see the pieces in place now, you understand.

... KNOCK! KNOCK! KNOCK!

You open the door and standing before you is the hooded girl. Before doffing her hood, she gestures to a portal swirling with energy behind her. “The choice is yours to make; stay here and wonder who the girl is, or take her hand and see how deep the water is?”
---
We aren’t just treasure hunters, seekers of wealth or fame. No, we are looking for the powerful and unique, and not just dangerous. We want the obscure, the out of place, the un-belonging, the gaps between where reality just doesn’t seem right.We are the curious, the inquisitive, the adventurous. We will seek out, collect, collate, investigate, analyze, all anomalous items, areas, and objects.

We want the curious, the ambitious, the driven, the talented. We want those who are willing to look beyond the veil and ask the question most wouldn't dare. We want you.
---
Keepers of the Void is an anomaly investigation group (in the same vein as SCP or MIB). They use a public facing Treasure hunting company as a front to cover up their other "work". The idea is to use bugs in the game as anomalies and investigate them, along with some deeper lore around the guild for members to uncover.

For Recruitment, you can DM me here, or contact me in-game under the same username.

content_md:
“By the might of the mountain and the wisdom of the forge, Khaz Modan stands united!”
_______________________________________________________
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/utEQqNF.jpeg)
Greetings, travelers of Azeroth!

Are you looking for a guild that embraces the rich lore of Dwarves and Gnomes? Tired of lifeless guilds that exist in name only? Do you want to experience meaningful roleplay, community-driven storylines, and a genuine sense of belonging?

Allow me to proudly introduce…

The Kingdom of Ironforge!
A new guild forged in the heart of Khaz Modan, is here to unite the Dwarven and Gnomish RP communities! We have a bold, immersive, and in game inspired guild and community focused on reviving and evolving what Dwarven and Gnomish RP can truly be.
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/UUrfgmc.png)
Who We Are:
The Kingdom of Ironforge is a quality-first guild designed for those who want to:
- Dive into authentic Dwarf/Gnome RP inspired by questlines, lore, and in-game events.
Take part in weekly RP scenes within Ironforge itself from political intrigue in the Senate to pints shared in the Forlorn Cavern.
Join military RP in the Ironforge Guard or the King’s Army.
Embark on Explorer’s League expeditions across Khaz Modan and beyond.
Participate in public events, joint adventures, and storylines with plot twists worthy of a Game of Thrones episode (Dwarven edition, of course!).
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/UUrfgmc.png)
What Makes Us Different:
Unlike many guilds that never deliver on their promises, the **Kingdom of Ironforge** is committed to:
- Canon-friendliness – Lore-abiding stories based in the world Blizzard built.
Inclusive immersion – We welcome any character that makes sense in the setting.
Multi-faceted RP – Political, military, religious, tavern, and exploration RP… all in one.
Community over cliques – No elitism. No gatekeeping. Just genuine camaraderie.
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/UUrfgmc.png)
We are not a socialite RP guild that never does anything. We’re not a spam-recruiting mess that never RPs. We are a real, functioning RP guild with actual content, character growth, and cross-guild collaborations where all are welcomed! ![:slight_smile:](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f642.svg)
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/UUrfgmc.png)
Our Long-Term Vision:
We aim to build a Khaz Modanian cultural revival — including:

Political RP through the Senate of Ironforge.
Military campaigns through the King’s Army and Mountaineers.
Holy RP with the Church of Ironforge and the Hall of Mysteries.
Gnomish brilliance in Tinker Town and Mechagon innovation.
Explorer’s League expeditions to distant lands (with dungeon crawls and discovery).

 **Massive server events to unite guilds against common foes!**

Whether you’re a noble Thane, a snow-bitten mountaineer, a hopeful archaeologist, or a pint-swinging tavernkeep — there’s a place for you here.
![Image](https://i.imgur.com/UUrfgmc.png)
Races & Themes Welcomed:
- Dwarves – Bronzebeard, Dark Iron, Wildhammer, **Earthen** (preferred but **ALL ALLIANCE RACES** WELCOMED!)
Gnomes – Standard and Mecha/Leper gnome variants
Explorer’s League Affiliates!
ALL Members of the Grand Alliance welcomed (just with preference towards dwarves and earthen or (mecha)gnomes!
Characters who fit naturally into Dwarven-Gnomish RP themes
If your character has a logical reason to be in Ironforge, we’re excited to have you!
 **Final Words:**
- We’re here to **Make Azeroth Great Again** (with more walk-up RP and less elitism).
We’re here to **revive world RP** and **city RP within Ironforge!**
We’re here to **unite the clans** and birth a **new era of Dwarven storytelling.**
 **Join us at the Great Forge.** **The ale is hot, the anvils ring true, and your story is waiting to be forged!**

/w or DM Ahzgadum in-game to learn more or get an invite.
Discord available upon request for deeper coordination.
_______________________________________________________
 **“Fer Khaz Modan! … Or Eat Dwarven Lead!”**

author: Gilneasforever
subject: [A-RP] [Nord] The Gilneas Brigade
content_md:
Sons and daughters of Gilneas! The world calls us arrogant. They call us pig-headed. They call us headstrong. And they are correct! But make no mistake, we are neither fools nor ungrateful. The Old King is slain and our home is free, thanks to the Alliance. We owe them a debt we could never repay in a thousand years, but we will try. The House of Nobles stands by as enemies overrun Stormwind, the scum of the Blackrock Mountain bear down on Dun Morogh, and the Elves of the north have nothing but their tears and the blood of their kin. I do not intend to stand idly by.

Rise now, my brothers and sisters, and rise with pride! The House of Greymane calls for your sword once more, to restore our name to one we should be proud to bear! For Gilneas!

 **Who we are:**

The Gilneas Brigade is a new Alliance-centric RP Guild, based on the unit from WC3, aiming to repay the debt Gilneas owes to the Alliance, whether that be through military aid or other means. We are actively hostile to the Worgen and Scourge, and are not afraid to cross blades with the Horde. Our guild base in Southshore reflects this, we are only a stone’s throw away from those that would threaten to undo the Alliance. Dwarves and humans are welcome, reflecting the lore established in WC3, and special cases may be made for other Alliance races.

What we offer:
- Roleplay opportunities, both casual and story-driven.

- Levelling, Gilneas needs the best soldiers it can get.

- A welcoming community. The spirit of our kingdom inhabits us all.
If you are interested, please reach out to Salten in game or check out our thread on the TurtleWoW discord!

“The blood of the old empire still flows through our veins. Its temples may lie in ruin, its banners may be dust… but the will of the Loa endures.”

The Second Gurubashi Empire is a troll-led RP-PvP guild on Turtle WoW, calling all who wish to see the glory of the empire restored — warriors, shadow hunters, witch doctors, and allies from every corner of Azeroth who revere the Loa.

We are not servants of Hakkar — his dark hunger shattered the old empire. Instead, we walk the path of the true Loa, honoring their power and restoring balance to the jungles, the sands, and beyond.

Immersive Roleplay: Forge stories of conquest, diplomacy, and divine favor.

RP-PvP Campaigns: Join warbands in imperial crusades and border skirmishes across Azeroth.

Events & Rituals: Loa ceremonies, arena games, imperial councils, and more.

Diverse Opportunities: From loyal warriors and priests to imperial diplomats and explorers.
